proposed_from.topic: Pool-rank recovery of cell-type Poisson-CPCM effects from designed bulk mixtures. For K invariant type-specific nonnegative-integer count vectors, observe replicate raw-count pools with known integer composition matrix M, independent cells, no cross-cell interaction, and no unknown thinning or normalization. Prove that full column rank of M is necessary and sufficient for uniform recovery of all unrestricted type joint laws, fully crediting Shih--Hero's log-transform inversion and using positive independent-Poisson aliases for the converse. On a declared compact, causally sufficient, pairwise-identifiable nonlinear Poisson-CPCM subclass, transfer recovery to labeled type DAGs and fixed truncated-factorization intervention contrasts. Give a normwise lower-envelope stability theorem involving ||M+||, and, on a prespecified finite PGF grid, derive replicate-well delta covariance, sample-split graph selection, and pointwise sandwich-Wald inference under certified graph-separation and Jacobian margins. Consumer: Luo--Sun--Zhang's empirical bulk-gene causal-recoverability workflow, prospectively redesigned with linearly independent known-composition replicate pools. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The score-blind presolve derived the full-rank inverse and positive-Poisson converse, verified a nonlinear three-node CPCM witness with intervention contrasts 3 and 25, established normwise stability and cross-type/grid covariance, and proved existence of a separating finite grid for compact positive-polynomial Poisson DAG families from score-information positivity, signed-PGF uniqueness, and compactness. A 27-point pilot had component-Jacobian singular values 0.00326480 and 0.00262027; Shih--Hero and transform-GMM collisions, rank-deficient graph aliases, finite-grid nonparametric aliases, unknown channels, vanishing edges, and pooling attenuation were checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Produce an explicit certified grid with a positive wrong-graph score gap, uniform within-graph Jacobian lower bound, controlled PGF truncation, and useful propagated contrast precision over the compact parameter boxes. EARLY KILL TEST: For p=3, M=[[1,1],[1,2]], coefficients in [1/2,3], and grid {0.8,0.9,0.97}^3, certify separation from all 24 incorrect single-type DAGs and both witness Jacobians by interval/global optimization; an exact collision kills that protocol, and failure of useful precision after one prespecified grid refinement stops the practical launch. seed_details.anchor_location: Definition 10, Lemma 11, Consequence 6, and Appendix C.5 on printed pages 8--11 and 47
seed_details.kernel: For the fixed three-gene positive-polynomial Poisson CPCM, certify on the prespecified \(27\)-point PGF grid a positive distance from all \(24\) wrong labeled DAGs, positive true-model Jacobian margins, and a rigorous truncation error small enough to preserve those inequalities.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin's full-law bivariate incompatibility step by finite-vector separation, then replace qualitative noncoincidence by interval branch-and-bound over every compact wrong-graph parameter box.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for finite-grid Poisson causal DAG PGF identification, pooled-count PGF causal recovery, and known-composition CPCM mixtures located no paper occupying this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Immediate from Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin because identifiable compact graph images have positive separation.
seed_details.rebuttal: Compact full-law images yield existence of some separating evaluations, but not a certificate for the stated grid, a numerical gap, a uniform Jacobian margin, truncation error, or useful propagated precision.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The focal object is the proof-producing certificate \(\mathfrak C_0\), and the claim is uniform over compact parameter boxes rather than a floating-point witness.
seed_details.burned_reason: The selected finite-grid-certificate seed required a complete outward-rounded Xi0/Xi1 proof object; no executable bounded certifier existed and D0.5 rejected substitution by conditional machinery.

seed_details.kernel: Full column rank of the known composition matrix is necessary and sufficient for uniform recovery of every labeled collection of unrestricted multivariate count laws from independent replicate pool laws.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the Shih--Hero log-transform inverse for sufficiency, but prove necessity with an interior family of positive independent-Poisson aliases indexed by \(\ker(M)\).
seed_details.destination_search: Shih--Hero gives the inverse, Chen--Cao--Bu studies a richer joint-path experiment, and Thoppe restricts components to known exponential bases; no source found states this exact independent-row unrestricted-count-law frontier.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Immediate from Shih--Hero because their pseudoinverse already recovers component transforms.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their construction supplies and receives credit for sufficiency; the exact unrestricted multivariate necessity and positive interior alias are additional, and this remains an enabling theorem.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposal does not market logarithmic inversion as original and states both directions.

seed_details.kernel: Derive a replicate-well PGF central limit law, full covariance after \(M^{+}\) unpooling, and sample-split pointwise Wald inference for smooth Poisson-CPCM intervention contrasts under a certified graph gap.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Form the same-well covariance \(H_j(z_\ell\odot z_{\ell'})-H_j(z_\ell)H_j(z_{\ell'})\) before applying the logarithm, \(M^{+}\), graph selection, and the contrast delta map.
seed_details.destination_search: Transform-GMM and direct-sample CPCM consistency are occupied separately, but no located source gives their pooled graph-selected intervention-contrast limit law.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Routine delta method after Chen--Cao--Bu and Carrasco--Florens.
seed_details.rebuttal: The limit argument is standard once selection is fixed, so this is a supporting rung; the full cross-grid, cross-type covariance and graph event are still absent from those papers.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The limit law and covariance are named focal objects.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section 4.2 (functional consistency under linear aggregation and affine ANM/PNL consequences), Section 6, and Appendix D; Section 4.3 concerns conditional-independence consistency
seed_details.kernel: Transfer recovered labeled type laws to labeled type DAGs and supported truncated-factorization effects on a causally sufficient pairwise-identifiable Poisson-CPCM subclass.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace preservation of one aggregate's structural form by recovery from several designed independent mixtures, then invoke CPCM identification at the recovered-law layer.
seed_details.destination_search: Bulk-level causal recovery and direct-sample CPCM recovery appear separately, but not through known integer mixtures.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Immediate corollary of Shih--Hero and Bodik--Chavez-Demoulin.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is a composition corollary and is retained for consumer value, not as the standalone novelty kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The corollary is not inflated into a new graph-identification principle.

seed_details.kernel: Show that a finite rational PGF grid jointly separates all compact positive-polynomial Poisson DAG images and has a uniform within-graph Jacobian lower bound.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Combine signed-PGF uniqueness, score-information positivity, and compact subcovers over parameters and unit tangent directions.
seed_details.destination_search: No finite-evaluation theorem was found in CPCM work; numerical certification papers address polynomial roots rather than this analytic PGF family.
seed_details.red_team_objection: A routine compactness consequence once the model is identifiable.
seed_details.rebuttal: Graph separation uses compactness, but uniform immersion also requires injectivity of every distributional derivative; it remains a bridge because it gives no useful explicit grid.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The result is uniform over compact graph classes.

seed_details.anchor_location: Main Fisher-information design theorem and the square-path allocation case
seed_details.kernel: Choose the integer composition matrix and replicate allocation to minimize worst-case intervention-contrast variance subject to a positive graph-gap certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace continuous probe allocation by joint discrete mixture-row and allocation choice, adding graph separation as a hard constraint.
seed_details.destination_search: Tomography optimizes probes and RNA deconvolution studies conditioning, but no target-specific integer causal-mixture design was located.
seed_details.red_team_objection: A direct optimal-design translation of He et al.
seed_details.rebuttal: Integer row choice and the graph-gap constraint make the feasible set nonconvex, but the pilot does not yet support a global optimality certificate.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is a genuine chosen-design problem, but it changes the requested exact-identification angle.

seed_details.anchor_location: Results and Conclusions on messenger-RNA content and mixture linearity
seed_details.kernel: For interval-calibrated composition or capture matrices, characterize sharp intervention bounds and the critical uncertainty radius at which the labeled DAG ceases to be unique.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact inversion by optimization over every admissible channel before imposing PGF compatibility and graph factorization.
seed_details.destination_search: Molinari treats a set-valued linear operator, but no located paper combines it with PGF deconvolution and graph-dependent intervention functionals.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Immediate application of Molinari's linear-system region.
seed_details.rebuttal: Nonlinear PGF compatibility and alternative DAG factorizations prevent reduction to Molinari's finite probability simplex.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The critical radius is a named focal object, but this is a partial-identification pivot.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section on component number and weight-matrix geometry
seed_details.kernel: Derive a recovery frontier balancing \(\lVert M^{+}\rVert\), pooled-PGF attenuation, grid location, and the CPCM Jacobian.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace empirical condition-number comparison by exact propagated transform covariance and optimize the largest contrast variance.
seed_details.destination_search: No closed observed-data frontier for this nonlinear causal contrast was located.
seed_details.red_team_objection: Just a condition-number bound with extra factors.
seed_details.rebuttal: Pooling can improve \(\lVert M^{+}\rVert\) while exponentially worsening log-PGF variance, but an exact two-regime frontier is not yet derived.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped because the divergence frontier is not yet a derived object.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize which rank-deficient integer compositions nevertheless recover every labeled nonlinear Poisson-CPCM DAG and intervention contrast.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the independent-Poisson nullspace alias by a positive nonlinear CPCM convolution alias along an arbitrary null vector.
seed_details.destination_search: No general rank-deficient causal alias was located; only equal-column swaps and empty-DAG Poisson law aliases are available.
seed_details.red_team_objection: The unrestricted law converse already proves the causal converse.
seed_details.rebuttal: It does not, because current nullspace aliases have empty DAGs and zero cross-coordinate effects.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped because the needed nonlinear alias family has not been constructed.
